stem.text: A student carried out the Benedict’s test on a sample and got a negative result.
What should the student do to confirm there are no sugars present in the sample?

A.text: boil the sample for 5 minutes then repeat the Benedict’s test

B.text: boil with alkali, neutralise with hydrochloric acid and repeat the Benedict’s test

C.text: boil with hydrochloric acid, neutralise with alkali and repeat the Benedict’s test

D.text: repeat the Benedict’s test but add more Benedict’s reagent
